name: Face the Knight - Mask Fix
teaser: Rendering fixes for the Knight's mask and a bonus
description_html:
🎭 Simple Knight Mask Fix

A lightweight and efficient solution to fix the Knight boss mask rendering bug that appeared after Tarkov’s 0.15/0.16 update.

🐛 The Problem

After recent Tarkov updates, the Knight boss appears without his iconic mask rendering on his face, simply invisible. I remember feeling my blood run cold when I first saw him in that mask.

✨ The Solution

This mod fixes the issue by replacing the corrupted mask pack with a working version, ensuring that the Knight correctly displays his signature Death Knight mask.

🎨 Bonus Feature: Custom Launcher Background

Want to customize your SPT launcher? This mod includes an optional feature to set a custom background image! How to use a custom background:

  1. Place your image PNG (recommended 1920x1080) in the assets/ folder.
  2. Enjoy your custom launcher!
  3. Edit config/config.json and set enabled:"false", (if you don’t want to use it.)
  4. Restart your server.

📋 Features

✅ Fixes automatic rendering of the Knight’s mask

✅Independent mod, does not need another mod to work

✅ Compatible with FIKA, Headless, and other mods

✅ No performance impact

✅ Optional custom launcher background

✅ Fully configurable

🔧 Installation

Open the downloaded zip file in 7-zip

Select the user folder in the zip file in 7-zip

Drag the user folder from 7-zip into your SPT folder

⚙️ Configuration

The mod works immediately, no configuration required to enable mask correction. However, you can customize the launcher background.
